name: megascenes-song
description: Create songs with vocals from a theme or your own lyrics, in the genre and mood you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give a theme or your lyrics, a genre and a mood, and get a song with vocals as an audio file.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the song in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The song plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For birthdays, jingles, gifts and songwriting sketches.

Limitations: original songs; it does not imitate a real singer's voice or copy an existing song. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Use your lyrics or a theme
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: A cheerful pop song for my sister Ana's 30th birthday
An acoustic folk song about a road trip along the coast
A short upbeat jingle for a bakery called Sunny Crumbs

positive.prompt: A cheerful pop song for my sister Ana's 30th birthday. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one song needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An acoustic folk song about a road trip along the coast. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one song needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which song models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The song models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A short upbeat jingle for a bakery called Sunny Crumbs. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my song and ship them to my store.
Send my song to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
